performance.verdict: Ads went dark Aug 6 — score of 100 is stale, not real.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 for 18 consecutive days (Aug 6–23); all 29 leads and $741.52 spend are pre-blackout. No active paid acquisition right now.
GHL shows 28 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — leads arriving but intake pipeline is completely empty, signaling a CRM intake leak.
Score of 100/green is machine-stale: it reflects a zero-spend period with no penalties triggered, not healthy performance. The triage signal is unreliable today.
IG reach spiked to 210–182 on Aug 21–23 despite zero paid spend, suggesting organic content is gaining traction; GBP actions also steady at 12 on Aug 20.
Search clicks rose +16.38% 7d vs prior 7d (31 clicks on Aug 22), but GA4 sessions fell -26.86% — directional gap may reflect GA4 double-count issue; watch only.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta spend to $65/day immediately — 18 dark days means zero lead intake against a 3/day volume target.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been at $0 spend since Aug 6 — 18 consecutive dark days confirmed in the daily series. Restart the CROA CBO campaign at $65/day (the pre-blackout floor from the SOW). Success check: at least 3 leads recorded within 72 hours of relaunch, CPL ≤ $45 (top of the July range). Confirm live by Aug 25 and report lead count by Aug 27.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 28 contacts, 0 opportunities created — confirm Andrew's Zoho-to-GHL pipeline stage mapping is firing correctly.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 28 contacts from the 28-day window but zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked — this is a confirmed intake leak, not an ads problem. Flag to Andrew to verify that lead form submissions are triggering the opportunity-creation workflow in GHL/Zoho. Success check: at least 1 opportunity created per new contact within 24 hours of the fix. Resolve by Aug 26 and confirm in Friday's Meta report.

suggestions.text: Watch IG organic reach (182 on Aug 23) through Aug 27 — if sustained ≥100/day, flag for Sohib as content momentum worth preserving in the creative brief.
suggestions.monday_update: IG reach spiked to 210 on Aug 21 and held at 182 on Aug 23 with zero paid spend behind it. Monitor daily reach through Aug 27; if it holds at or above 100/day for 4 consecutive days, surface to Sohib as evidence of organic traction that should inform the next Marwan/Rocco video shoot brief. No action before the re-check date.
